meta.source: 手作業で作成した文脈推測原稿

sentences: The tent served as a stopgap while the roof was being replaced.
It kept the rain off for three weeks and was taken down as soon as the tiles were on.

was taken down as soon as the tiles were on
items.reason: 三週間雨をしのぎ、瓦が載るとすぐ撤去されたと述べられています
